address: 11 Kra Road, Talat Yai, Mueang Phuket, Phuket, 83000, Thailand
bio: In its third generation of family ownership, this is one of Phuket’s best Hokkien-style fried noodle joints. Its charm is conjured up by a concoction of special flavours, the sounds of the wok and charcoal smells. Order the yellow hokkien noodles with an extra egg for a creamier texture....
